subject: english
stem: Sam forgot the code to a storage box. He checked the instruction card, entered the reset code, and opened the box. Which sentence summarizes the event?
options: Sam used the instruction card to reset the code and open the box.
The box was gray and sat on a shelf.

optionRationales.reason: Sam used the instruction card to reset the code and open the box.：問題、工具、結果完整。
The box was gray and sat on a shelf.：未提顏色且非主線。
Sam broke every storage box.：與 reset/open 相反。
Instruction cards are exciting stories.：無關評價。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「摘要保留初始目標或問題、關鍵因果轉折與結果，刪除不影響因果鏈的細節」可推出 Sam used the instruction card to reset the code and open the box.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Sam used the instruction card to reset the code and open the box. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
